4. **AssetsLoader reference-counting inconsistency** — `Base/AssetsLoader/AssetsLoader.cs`: `LoadAssetUniTask`/`LoadAssetTask` increment `count++` *before* loading; `LoadAssetAsync` increments *inside* the callback (only after success); `LoadAssetCoroutine` increments *after* `yield return` (after completion). - `Base/AssetsLoader/AssetsManager.cs:118` — `//TODO: 开启定时器,定时清理缓存` (cache cleanup timer not implemented).
- `C#/UGUI/Pages/SetUserNameUI/SetUserNameUI.cs:60` — `//TODO: 展示提示框`.
- `0 Core/.../PhotoStudio/PhotoStudioResultPanel.cs:86,100` — TODOs for drama system & NPC progress integration.
- `AssetsManager.cs` `LoadAssetTask` — `//??` marker.
- No `FIXME`/`HACK`/`BUG` markers in project code (those only appear in third-party Live2D/Cubism).

### Deprecated Unity APIs
- None in project code. The only `FindObjectOfType` usages are third-party (DOTween already marks it obsolete and wraps it; SRDebugger still uses it).

### Gaps / Caveats
- I could not retrieve the full body of `PlayerInputManager.cs` or `UIUtility.cs` (the read tool reported "unchanged since last read" despite no prior successful read — appears to be a caching glitch). The event-subscription leak risk (item #12) and LocalizationManager unsubscribe (#13) should be manually confirmed against those two files.
- `Assets/0 Core/1 Script/` minigame panels (Casino, Factory, Kitchen, PhotoStudio) were sampled via search rather than read line-by-line; they rely on a separate `PlayerInputActions`/config system and showed reasonable `Debug.LogWarning`/`LogError` guards and no empty catch blocks.

(2) Fix GameDataManager.Sleep() week-incrementing-every-day logic. (3) Fix AssetsManager.LoadAssetsCoroutine cache-miss branch to populate AssetsDic, and unify AssetsLoader ref-count timing. (4) Add null guards in AudioManager.PlayAudio(string) and try/catch + null checks in GameManager.Initialized(). (5) Verify PlayerInputManager.OnDisable calls Disable()/-= on the 4 performed handlers and LocalizationManager unsubscribes OnSelectedLocaleChanged. (6) Migrate AudioManager sync AudioClip loads to UniTask. Lower priority: cap targetFrameRate, rename StarGame/OnOnExitGame, consolidate AssetsManager loading APIs to UniTask.

head_limit.description: Optional: Claude Code aligned alias for 'maxResults'. When both are provided, head_limit wins. Pass 0 for unlimited (use sparingly — large result sets waste context).

offset.description: Optional: Number of matches to skip before returning results. Use this to continue after a truncated result's next offset.
